plan.title: Material PR to Split Auction PO

steps.note: Enable splitting one PR line across multiple vendors.
Enable event creation from the PR flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.

args.goal: On the single-stage auction create screen, set the evaluation duration to 30 minutes and add one Required Terms and Conditions clause, then stop with the saved schedule and clause visible

steps.note: Configure the required evaluation duration and T&C clause, which have no dedicated catalog domain step.
Invite exactly two QA vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bidding.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify the auction reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's portal bid at 100, including the vendor-side terms acceptance handled by the bid flow.
Verify Vendor A's bid was submitted.
Submit Vendor B's portal bid at 90.
Verify Vendor B's bid was submitted.
Wait for bidding to end before ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after both bids are available.
Verify two real vendor columns are shown.
Verify the lower bid ranks first, corresponding to Vendor B's 90 bid.
Check that the second bidding vendor, Vendor B in this plan, is Rank 1.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed auction.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase orders.
Verify the created purchase orders contain the two awarded line entries.
Return to the events list to verify the event reached history.
Open the History tab after the event lifecycle completes.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
